label: Screen Carousel
description: A product flow as a rail of 2-6 app screens: the centre screen primary, neighbours receded to the sides; on each cue the rail advances one screen and the caption under it swaps (title + line), with progress dots. Screens sit in a browser window, a phone (auto on a tall box) or bare. For 'step 1, step 2, step 3' walkthroughs.

screens.label: Screens in order: {src, title, caption, url, at}

src.description: Screenshot / image URL (brand-kit screenshot, upload, capture)

title.description: Feature name, shown as the caption headline

url.description: Address shown in the browser bar

at.description: Seconds this screen takes over (default: evenly through the scene)

device.label: browser | phone | none (default: phone on a tall box, else browser)

theme.label: Ink theme; omit to follow the measured scene ground

at.label: Seconds into the scene it enters (default 0.2)
